physicalReality.rule: Every object must be supported and correctly oriented: aligned pages inside the open folder, binder clip gripping one edge, magnifying glass resting naturally, and each receipt contained in its own separate lane.

requiredVisualFacts: One central open plain case folder containing a substantial clipped multi-page legal complaint packet
Exactly four distinct unbranded subscription receipts, each supported in its own visibly separate paper lane or shallow desk tray
Four lanes differentiated only by cyan, magenta, coral and lime colour bands, without logos or product-interface shapes
One magnifying glass resting over part of the complaint packet to show examination rather than judgment
Dark navy ground, warm cream paper, electric accents, hand-inked editorial detail and integrated screenprint texture
All four receipt lanes remain separate and no visual connector claims coordination among them
prohibitedContradictions: No verdict, guilt, liability, class certification, refund, damages or court-order implication
No merged arrows, connecting wires, conspiratorial strings, shared pipeline, handshake or other proven-collusion symbol
No gavels, scales of justice, court seals, judge benches, checkmarks, red X marks, victory or defeat symbols
No company logos, brand colours presented as identities, app icons, product interfaces or recognizable corporate marks
No visible words, letters, numbers, dates, filing stamps, signatures, watermarks or generated pseudo-text
No people, hands, faces, robots, humanoid AI, MAiVEN or TRAiLBLAZER
No question mark as the central concept and no abstract four-arrow diagram replacing the concrete filing scene
